name: agent-lore/influx-inbox
description: Use when an agent needs to submit a URL or PDF to the Influx inbox for ingestion into the Lithos knowledge base. Covers creating the required influx:inbox task, mandatory metadata fields (kind, url/local_path, submitted_by), the optional force and tier overrides for curated references that must be ingested in full, validation rules, and how to check ingestion results.
